description: Shell script for system information retrieval and network configuration, including CPU core detection, MAC address retrieval, network status, and system info functions.

methods.name: getLastModifiedTimeOfFile
methods.description: Returns the last modified time of a file in a specific format.

methods.name: get_core_value
methods.description: Detects CPU core type (ATOM or ARM) based on system files and commands.

methods.name: get_interface_value
methods.description: Determines network interface name based on device type.

methods.name: get_mac_address
methods.description: Retrieves MAC address based on core type and device specifics.

methods.name: getMacAddressOnly
methods.description: Gets the MAC address of the primary network interface.

methods.name: network_commn_status
methods.description: Checks network connectivity and status based on device core type.

methods.name: getSHA1
methods.description: Calculates SHA1 checksum of a file.

methods.name: get_model_value
methods.description: Retrieves device model name based on core type.
